rubric: One answer with four plausible alternatives
Observed runtime or explicit document-backed contract
Distinct reasoning, professional formatting and appropriate prerequisites

records.finding: The octal literal and decimal numeric string use different parsing rules; the explicit addition removes ambiguity about string concatenation.
Three coalescing assignments distinguish null, missing and existing zero values; the side-effect counter shows which right operands execute.
The level on continue is essential: the outer loop advances rather than merely skipping the next inner iteration. Both loops and limits are visible.
Repeated flipped values overwrite earlier keys; the output choices represent keeping first, keeping both and confusing original keys with values.
Exact and inexact division are inspected as types as well as values; this avoids treating every slash result as a float.
The increment counter makes short-circuit evaluation observable; the stated operators and their order determine one result.

Replaced a capture-mode comparison too close to archived PQ-014. The final question tests nonpersistent local updates to a value-captured scalar across repeated invocations; it is distinct from static local counters.
The nested arrays contain no objects or explicit references; value-copy semantics therefore apply through the displayed nested update.
Heredoc and nowdoc use the same indented closing boundary, separating indentation stripping from interpolation. The source is preserved verbatim.
The shorthand conditional evaluates its condition once; the explicitly repeated call in the full conditional is a distinct side effect.
The debug representation and JSON public-property representation have different hooks. No claim is made that debug redaction secures serialization.
The inner output happens before __toString throws; the enclosing echo never receives its completed concatenation. The catch is visible.
The unpacked array supplies writable elements to the by-reference variadic parameter. The final original array exposes the shared updates.
The second strtok initialization replaces the internal continuation state; the final token belongs to that second input.
The partial sscanf result retains the successfully parsed field and null for the unsuccessful conversion; it is not an all-or-nothing parse.
Both DatePeriod flags are stated, and the dates avoid daylight-saving ambiguity. Exclusion of the start and inclusion of the end must both be applied.
The priority queue extracts higher priorities first and iteration consumes entries; distinct priorities avoid unspecified tie ordering.
The same method name resolves differently from an inaccessible external call and an authorized internal call; __call is not a universal interception hook.
Attribute target validity is checked when instantiated, not merely when reflected. Promoted parameter and property metadata make the two outcomes differ.
Separate complete files explicitly identify the strict caller and weak defining file. Parameter checking and return coercion have different controlling sites.
Rewinding at the first yield differs from rewinding after advancement; the catch and observations isolate that generator state rule.
Automatic collection is disabled explicitly; removing the strong variable leaves a self-cycle until the requested cycle collection runs.
The IEEE-754 and integer-width premises are explicit. Adjacent large integer IDs lose their distinction when converted to floats; formatting cannot restore it.
The promoted constructor default supplies an argument, not initialized storage in an object created without the constructor. Reflection observations separate them.
The fixture is locally authored serialized data. __wakeup runs during unserialize before the later type gate, so that gate cannot undo its side effect.
The string conversion returns a new value; assigning that return is the required repair. The options distinguish storage from comparison and discarded calls.
The sparse array prevents count-minus-one from identifying its last key; array_pop returns and removes the last element rather than peeking or shifting.
The requested result is a filename extension label, not content validation. A multi-dot basename distinguishes final-extension parsing from naive splitting.
Unsetting a local reference binding differs from writing through it; the requirement is to change the shared value while preserving the other variable.
Returning the match result satisfies the function contract. Echo, print’s integer return and an unused local value fail for different realistic reasons.
The caller changes working directory and the included file is shown separately. __DIR__ anchors the path to the loader rather than the process directory.
The post_max_size premise covers the entire body. Empty POST and FILES are not evidence that the browser omitted an upload or that only a file limit fired.

The validation predicate was strengthened after a destroy-only candidate appeared to rotate an ID by clearing it. It now requires an active session, a nonempty changed ID, retained data and removal of the old file.
The PDO MySQL native-prepares condition is explicit; each occurrence needs its own named placeholder. Emulation-specific behavior is not generalized.
The recursion budget prevents runaway execution in wrong candidates. Post-decrement, pre-decrement and subtraction differ in the child argument and parent multiplier.
The requested mode must create if absent, retain existing bytes and permit positioned writes. The r, w and a alternatives each miss a different requirement.
The fixture uses a regular temporary file. Truncation changes length but leaves the cursor, so a rewind is necessary before the next write.
The race is between a successful check and a later open. Handling the actual open result is required even when a precheck was true.
MySQL 8.4 DDL implicit commit is a server-specific premise; separating ALTER from the business transaction avoids a false rollback guarantee.
The custom error handler’s return value and error level are explicit. Returning false requests default handling; throwing changes control flow.
A write filter retains base64 state across chunks; encoding each chunk independently inserts padding at the wrong boundaries. The small fixture has no external stream.
Internal parent traversal is permitted only when normalization remains inside the root. The defect is a collision between different raw names resolving to one destination.
The signature contract is over exact received bytes. Whitespace trimming, serialization and JSON re-encoding produce different byte sequences even when data seems equivalent.
The elapsed-time calculation uses monotonic nanoseconds and the matching unit conversion; wall-clock timestamps and clamping do not satisfy the same budget rule.
The offset returned by PCRE remains a byte offset with the Unicode modifier. The multibyte prefix distinguishes byte slicing from character indexing.
A Countable object with count zero is still truthy as an object. The question contrasts object conversion with the explicit count operation.
Appending during by-value and by-reference array iteration has different visitation behavior. The controlled contrast runs both without an unbounded append.
The class constant exists, while the similarly spelled instance property does not. Diagnostics are observed without conflating the two access forms.
Echoing false and JSON-encoding false yield different text. The explanation ties this to output conversion rather than treating JSON as display formatting.
The concrete child implements the abstract protected method used by the inherited template method. Visibility and implementation obligations are both visible.
The provider is nonnull but its lookup returns null. An ordinary second hop fails; each nullable dereference requires its own nullsafe operator.
Recursive merge preserves conflicting scalar values in an array rather than replacing the scalar. The fixture is a scalar collision, not just nested-key merging.
array_walk passes a modifiable value but not a renamable array key. Assigning the callback’s key variable does not rebuild the source key map.
The files share a namespace but not import aliases. The second file needs its own import or qualified class name; require does not transfer lexical imports.
The HTTP contract calls for preserving a POST method and body. Status 307 supplies that redirect behavior; the scenario avoids treating every redirect identically.
Recursive array walking visits leaves, including no leaves inside empty branches. The callback cannot infer every container from its leaf invocations.
The SQLite result demonstrates why SELECT rowCount is not a portable count API. The answer is scoped to the shown driver rather than asserting every driver returns zero.
PARAM_INT binding converts the supplied text in the fixture; it is not validation that the original input was a valid integer. The observed zero match exposes the difference.
The CLI fixture creates an ordinary file and matching metadata only. PHP’s upload provenance registry is separate from the shape of FILES entries.
The values are numeric-looking identifiers whose text matters. JSON_NUMERIC_CHECK destroys their plus sign or leading zeros, so explicit value typing is needed.
The get-only interface property and readonly narrower implementation use PHP 8.4 property variance. The advanced prerequisites and version assumptions are explicit.
Reflection assignment uses coercive semantics even though direct assignment in the strict file rejects the same string. Both paths are observed.
The initial URL allowlist does not constrain later redirect destinations. The scenario requires validating each target or disabling uncontrolled redirects.
The bcrypt input pair differs only beyond 72 bytes. The fixture verifies both against one hash, exposing truncation without claiming this applies to every password algorithm.
A mutually compatible encoder and decoder can both violate the external alphabet. The independent FBFF wire vector tests interoperability rather than only round-trip consistency.
Padding preserves string content and supplies a minimum width. The options contrast left/right padding, numeric conversion and truncation with explicit short and long inputs.
The requirement pairs keys and corresponding values. Filling, merging and replacing arrays do not establish that relationship.
The scalar category includes booleans and excludes null and containers. The options test type classification rather than truthiness.
The explicit wire representation fixes hour format, minutes and colon-bearing offset. Nearby date format letters represent realistic token mistakes.
The required byte is LF. Literal backslash-n, CR and CRLF remain distinct choices; no platform newline assumption is hidden.
The reversed-bound rule requires an explicit empty result because range itself descends. Singleton and inclusive endpoints are also verified.
array_rand returns a key. All keys and values are deliberately disjoint, so membership checks validate the lookup behavior without relying on a particular random draw.
Separate instances with equal identifier text must compare equal, while 01 and 1 remain distinct. Object identity and numeric equality each violate one requirement.
The connect and total timeout units and scopes are given. The total includes connection establishment rather than adding another full interval afterward.
The fallback must be returned locally while successful values remain intact. A global handler does not resume the failed call, and finally-return overrides success.
INI raw scanning preserves off, null and leading-zero strings. This replaced a contemplated date-error question that overlapped an earlier batch.
The logger contract uses context.exception for the original outer Throwable. Message-only, inner-only and alternate-key options lose a different required aspect.
Reflection invokeArgs interprets associative keys as parameter names. The UI field labels differ from the method’s parameter names, so positional normalization is necessary.
The limit is cumulative expanded bytes checked before writing. Bounded chunks, successful full writes and a fixed decoded fixture keep the test’s guarantee precise.
Composer’s real platform check must ignore config.platform emulation. The command is reviewed against documentation, not claimed to run against an external install.
A shorter candidate exposes the wrong comparison length in the prefix check. The repair uses the required prefix length rather than the candidate length.
Overlapping occurrences require advancing one position after each match. The aaaa/aa case distinguishes that contract from substr_count’s nonoverlapping count.
The map contract ignores insertion order while preserving strict value equality. Sorting keys fixes order without coercing different values into equality.
The chosen midpoint distinguishes half-even from default half-away rounding; the control inputs do not. Exact simple binary-representable inputs avoid incidental float ambiguity.
HTTP method tokens are case-sensitive under the stated contract. This differs from case-insensitive field-name handling in an earlier question.
Property promotion assigns the readonly property before the constructor body. A padded string reaches the forbidden second write; separate declaration permits one normalized initialization.
The first multi-digit suffix distinguishes lexical from natural order. Simpler numeric suffixes remain useful controls without exposing the comparator defect.
SQLite foreign-key enforcement is explicitly disabled on this connection. A missing nonnull parent tests rejection; existing parents and null do not.
A singleton can match despite the incorrect IN binding. The multi-ID case proves that a bound comma-containing string is not multiple SQL values.
The thousands boundary exposes the unwanted separator. Smaller positive, negative and zero cases verify padding and sign without exercising grouping.
The graph is explicitly acyclic; the defect is loss of shared identity among copied children, not nontermination on cycles. Memoization preserves one copy per original node.
The Fiber test forces two calls past the check before either marks the token. Sequential replay passes, so the overlapping schedule is essential; no distributed atomicity claim is made.
The replica lag has no bound and the primary commit is confirmed. A fixed delay or isolation setting cannot guarantee immediate replica visibility.
The partial-update contract assigns separate meanings to absent, null and empty string. The design must carry presence as well as a nullable value through the boundary.
The policy explicitly honors revocations before execution. Signed enqueue-time decisions prove integrity, not current authorization.
Both cache writers remain active during rollout. Versioned key namespaces separate incompatible representations, whereas a one-time flush cannot prevent repopulation.
Existing third-party parents must remain. An interface adds the required nominal method signatures without attempting multiple class inheritance or treating traits as types.
The guarantee applies before the first timeout. Reserved capacity and an A concurrency cap satisfy it; timeout, breaker and jitter settings alone do not.
The transaction is confirmed aborted with no external side effects. Fresh reads and decision logic belong inside the bounded retry, unlike an ambiguous-commit recovery scenario.
The required hooks must run, but deployment credentials must remain inaccessible. Lockfiles and non-root execution do not supply that trust boundary; artifact review remains separate.
